mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals persistent labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in UNRATE > 8.5% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent positive quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in concurrent GDPC1/INDPRO growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
